title: Range preservation by the noise operator
statement: For a natural number $n$, suppose $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ takes values in $[0,1]$, and let $0\le\rho\le1$. Then $T_\rho f(x)\in[0,1]$ for every $x\in\{0,1\}^n$.
replaced: Let $T_\rho$ denote Boolean noise with real correlation $\rho$, whose Fourier multiplier on a set of size $k$ is $\rho^k$. If $f:\{0,1\}^n\to[0,1]$ and $0\le\rho\le1$, then $(T_\rho f)(x)\in[0,1]$ for every $x$.
